name: What are the transportation options for getting around Palm Beach and to attractions?

mainEntity.name: What are the transportation options for getting around Palm Beach and to attractions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Getting around Palm Beach and to its attractions is primarily done by car, which offers the most flexibility. However, other options exist. The Palm Beach Freebee offers on-demand electric vehicle service in specific zones. Public transportation, such as Palm Tran buses, connects various parts of Palm Beach County. Taxis and rideshare services are also readily available. When deciding on transportation, consider your budget and the number of attractions you plan to visit, as renting a car might be more cost-effective for extensive exploration compared to frequent use of rideshares.
acceptedAnswer.description: Transportation in Palm Beach mainly relies on cars, but options include the Freebee, Palm Tran buses, taxis, and rideshares. Consider your budget and number of destinations to choose the most cost-effective method.
